import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689764/attempts/e81e54f2f2424f1b8a6d71322cea1218/system/state/workspace/programs/task-50efcd12.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text('def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # The horizontal separator is followed by the moved object; append its 8-color stop line.
    # With no object below it, the object is the single marker above the separator.
    w=len(grid[0]); sep=next((i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]==2), None)
    if sep is not None:
        # Bring the marker immediately below the separator and place the stop line after it.
        markers=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==9 and r<sep]
        if markers:
            r,c=markers[-1]
            out[r][c]=6
            out[sep+1]=[9]*w
            out[sep+2]=[8]*w
    return out
')

G=[[6]*28 for _ in range(11)];G[4][26]=9;G[5]=[2]*28
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',p);mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
O=mod.transform(G)
print(O)
